lines.en: I'm telling you, Ross, she wants you.
She barely knows me. We just live in the same building.
Any contact?
She lent me an egg once.
You're in!
Oh, right.
Hey, Ross.
Hey!
Come on, Ross, you gotta get back in the game here, okay?
The Rachel thing's not happening. Your ex-wife's a lesbian.
I don't think we need a third.
Uh, excuse me, can we get an egg over here still in the show?
Thanks.
An egg?
Yeah, you're gonna go up to her and say,
here's your egg back. I'm returning your egg.
I think it's winning.
Come on, I think it's insane.
She'll love it.
Thank you. Thank you. Here.
Go with the egg, my friend.
Go, go, go, go, go, go, go.
Think it'll work?
No way. It's suicide. The man's got an egg.
